capabilities.justification: run() reads REPL input lines from process stdin via io::stdin().lock().lines().
run() writes prompts and evaluation output to process stdout (write! / println!).
Mode::Async evaluates each input on a dedicated OS thread via std::thread::spawn.
Mode::Async waits on the result channel with recv_timeout(tick_ms) to drive the waiting animation.

justification: Sync mode, run_with_io and the trait objects are pure. The convenience run() wrapper uses process stdin/stdout, and Mode::Async spawns one OS thread per evaluation and waits on a timeout tick.
